intent: The librarian's FIFTH tenure behaviour, beside crossing honesty, provenance append, promotion and lazy decay: a node proven wrong keeps its residence and carries its wrongness at every later read, and a turn whose answer has since changed can name the earlier question it revises. REFUTATION IS AN INPUT, NEVER A DISCOVERY — it arrives as a stated correction at the chat surface (or as a re-shelved passage superseding an earlier one) and the loop's job is to honour it forever after at read, never to go looking for one. Judged in _label_evidence beside decay: arithmetic at read, no clock, no daemon, no generate spent on deciding truth.
why: Akien, 2026-08-10, the sentence the node exists for: 'the importance of things proven wrong does persist. that's experience. but it must carry that it's proven wrong when revisited.' And the frame that makes it ordinary machinery rather than an error path: 'contradiction will happen. it happens inside my head all the time and has to be resolved.' The lived symptom today: an earned node that becomes WRONG has no path — tenure handles corroboration (attestations) and neglect (decay), and nothing at all handles being mistaken, so the librarian would go on answering from a fact it has been told is false. Measured context, CairnCommons/notes/2026-08-10-persistent-chatbot-field-survey.json: update-and-invalidation, not recall, is the step production memory systems measurably lose on (97.8% of 10,134 entries junk after 32 days in one independent audit), and it is the one place the librarian's tenure loop was already standing without this behaviour. Traces to Telos aim 4 (build something that thinks the way Akien does) and Law 7 (a record of truth may never collapse an error into a coherent shape — which is exactly what deleting a refuted node would do).
how: BORROWED WHOLE FROM cairn/machines/ruling's supersession door (grown 2026-08-02), cited not grafted: 'retires by stamping the CONFIRMED successor — never the retired record, which stays on disk byte-identical, red under verify, and visible in list, but no longer OPEN.' Its refusals transfer nearly one-for-one — empty evidence refused, self-supersession refused, doubled retirement refused — and the sharpest one, 'an unconfirmed successor cannot outvote his signature', becomes STANDING GATES REFUTATION POWER: a born-hypothesis mint cannot retire an earned node. Crossing honesty extends unchanged: a refutation minted during a crossing cannot retire anything in that same crossing. WHERE BYTE-IDENTITY DOES NOT TRANSFER, AND WHY: a ruling packet is Akien's signed act, so its bytes are the point; a library node's `standing` is already a system-mutable ledger column that promotion writes. What transfers is the invariant underneath — the corpse is never deleted, its content and birth provenance are never rewritten, it stays visible in the walk. So refutation writes standing='refuted' through the SAME owner-gated update face promotion uses (db_domain's second write face) and APPENDS the refuter's id plus its evidence into provenance, the append pattern charter edge (b) already established for attestations. One write face, one owner, no second store. THE RECEIPTS HALF NEEDS NO NEW FIELD AND NO NEW EVENT: _tenure_on_resolution (loop.py:164) already returns the touched node_ids in every RESOLVED verdict, and every node carries provenance.question (loop.py:238) — so 'when you asked X I told you Y, since then Z' is a reader over what is already on disk. 'I was wrong' and 'I have something new' are one mechanism read from two sides.
falsifier: DONE when a node the librarian once answered from can be retired by a later crossing, and a subsequent walk returns that node PRESENT, LABELLED, AND NOT COUNTED, with the correction reachable from it — and when a turn whose answer has since changed can name the earlier question it revises. RED on any of: (1) a refuted node is deleted, or its content or birth provenance is rewritten (invalidate-don't-delete failed, Law 7); (2) a refuted node still counts as evidence toward RESOLVED; (3) a hypothesis-standing node retires an earned node (a guess outvoting earned knowledge); (4) a node refutes itself, or a same-crossing mint retires anything (crossing honesty broken at the new behaviour); (5) a revision is announced without naming the earlier question it revises, or naming a node the walk never held (minted attribution wearing a bibliography — the defect charter falsifier (13) already pins for summaries); (6) the model is asked WHICH SIDE IS TRUE (the host back in the answer path — a refutation is a recorded input, never a generated verdict). WRONG-INTENT TELLS, two and opposite: no refutation ever fires in live use (decorative — the same wrong-shape the charter watches for with 'every node still hypothesis weeks into live use'), or a refutation storm where nodes retire each other (the standing gate not holding). The one question no instrument in this build can answer — was a refutation ITSELF wrong — is Akien's, by his own word at the design session, and is what the WATCHME routes to him.

watchme.trigger: every pulse reaching the librarian's shim — the probe reads the refutation census from the librarian's own tree store (its component, its read), counting from an ERA FLOOR set to the MEASURED serving-process restart (ps lstart), never the disk landing (the 2026-08-08 stale-process lesson, applied at arming time). It fires a finding on any of three conditions: (a) one or more refutations have landed and stand un-adjudicated — the finding carries each one with its evidence, its refuter and the node it retired, so the question 'was this refutation itself wrong?' reaches the one instrument that can answer it; (b) >= 20 resolve crossings have accumulated since the era floor with ZERO refutations landed (the decorative tell — the behaviour built but never exercised); (c) refutations exceed 10% of the tree's nodes, or any single crossing lands more than one (the storm tell — the standing gate not holding).
watchme.enough: cleared by BOTH halves witnessed once each plus Akien's verdict: >= 1 refuted node observed in a later walk, returned present and labelled and not counted (the record holds AND the read honours it), AND >= 3 landed refutations adjudicated by Akien with his verdict on whether any was itself wrong. An existence claim on the mechanism and a measured answer on the question no code here can settle.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier (the default carrier), depositing the refutation census (count, refuters, retired nodes, evidence strings), the witnessing walk that returned a refuted node uncounted, and Akien's adjudications verbatim
watchme.nexus: the hypothesize tree via the chart deposit door (python3 -m cairn.machines.chart.live learn)
watchme.consumer: Akien, and the surface is part of the spec rather than an implementation detail: the finding fires into the SESSION-OPEN gate list he already passes every session (bin/cmd/slate renders it), never into a packet awaiting a visit — CLAUDE.md's own residue records that 'nothing makes me open a packet; the hook sees packets that exist, not rulings never recorded', so a human-nexus probe that files and waits inherits a known-failing intake. Secondarily the sieve-learning direction: the adjudicated refutation rate is the evidence that would move a hand-set gate, per I-learns-its-gates.

dials_declared: Hand-set at cast and declared per I-learns-its-gates, so none of them is a learned value stranded in a head. (1) The DECORATIVE TELL at 20 resolve crossings with zero refutations — copied deliberately from the tenure loop's own watch, which used 20 for the same 'built but never exercised' question; one dial, one meaning, rather than a second number for the same shape. (2) The STORM TELL at 10% of the tree refuted, or more than one retirement in a single crossing — the second half is the real tooth and needs no threshold at all (a crossing retiring two nodes is a shape, not a rate); the 10% is the weaker n=0 guess and is the one most likely to move first. (3) ENOUGH at 3 adjudicated refutations — the smallest count where 'he agreed every time' is distinguishable from a coincidence, the same reasoning PROMOTION_THRESHOLD = 2 used one rung down. All three tune against the probe's own live findings; none is measured yet, and the probe exists to move them.
out_of_bounds: AUTOMATIC DISCOVERY OF CONTRADICTION, killed at the /sorted gate rather than deferred vaguely: the walk is pure cosine, cosine finds nodes that are ALIKE, and a statement and its negation are alike — so proximity can never separate agrees from contradicts, and the only thing that could judge it is the host, which charter falsifier (8) bars from the answer path. If a real detector ever appears it is its own node, and this ticket's shape does not assume one. CROSS-TREE REFUTATION is the librarian charter's edge (l) filed question and is not this ticket's to answer. THE DESK (charter edge (f), 'unbuilt until the multi-day research face needs it') is the SIBLING intention from the same idea — the persistence face for protracted research, plan and progress — and casts its own node; it is not a child of this one.

Five pieces landed: trees.refute (ONE owner-gated update, invalidate never delete, six refusals in one pass), the read-time label placed ABOVE the earned pass-through, chat's literal 'correct: <node_id> <why>' prefix, the receipts reader, and 19+16+17 teeth sealed under netns. THE DISTINCTIONS WORTH CARRYING: (1) ONE HYPOTHESIS KILLED BY LAW 9 — the cast standing gate ('a node whose standing is hypothesis may not retire one whose standing is earned') was unbuildable as stated, because trees.deposit births EVERY node a hypothesis, so Akien's own correction could never retire anything earned; the gate would protect the corpus from its author. Rebuilt on provenance AUTHORITY — _REFUTER_AUTHORITIES, an ALLOWLIST holding {'correction'} today, so an unrecognized hand is still refused against earned knowledge (red is the default). The criterion's three named cases all still hold; a FOURTH now passes and is recorded as the deciding observation in the verdict. (2) THE ERA FLOOR MEASUREMENT SURPRISED — this ticket's watchme demanded a `ps lstart`, and the measurement found nothing to take one from: no librarian listener, ground_loop.service in auto-restart with ExecStart exiting 1. For this component the disk IS the serving face; the probe's header states the condition that makes that floor wrong (a long-lived listener). (3) THE SIBLING PROBE'S SUBSTRATE IS DEAD, re-measured here: 'commons' holds 0 rows, 'library' holds 84. This probe reads 'library'; the sibling's repair is its own ticket. (4) THE LIVE FIRE WAS A REAL CORRECTION, not a smoke test: it retired the hallucinated '/hex/payback/meter/measure/network_bandwidth' against Akien's own verbatim payback-meter line, and the next crossing returned it present at rank 4, labelled, uncounted, RESOLVED at 0.8295 off the others — while corroborating the correction node in the same act. (5) THE PROBE IS ALREADY BITING: trigger TRUE on condition (a), enough FALSE at 0 of 3 adjudications. It waits on Akien, and the adjudication intake is deliberately unwritten — recorded as an attestation with source 'adjudication' when he makes one, because adjudication is the owner's act (Law 6).
